suggested_solution: Monitor temperatures while gaming to identify potential thermal issues.
Ensure NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070Ti drivers are up-to-date (version 530.12.11 or later).
Check for Intel Core Ultra 9 BIOS updates (version 1.10 or later).
Run a thorough stress test to identify performance bottlenecks.
Adjust game settings, power management, and cooling settings to optimize performance.
Inspect the laptop's cooling system, fans, and heat sinks for any blockages or damage.
